lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jenny Smirnov is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Jenny is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d41: 🕯️ Jenny Smirnov is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Jenny kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Jenny's gone." Carolina looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Jenny." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Hilda blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Boiling Water (Level 1). Rolling boil for 1 minute kills most pathogens. The simplest safe water.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Jenny Smirnov, 41 days. The mantle passes to Hilda DeLuca.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Hilda DeLuca, 28 — a line cook. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally, Rain Dancer, Cornucopia.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Jenny — and Jenny is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Carolina, Ava, David and 1 more speak for Hilda — "Jenny trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Hilda before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d47: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
